diff.classification_rule: Every path appears exactly once in components[].files; a group classification applies to each path in that group.

classifications.KEEP: Retain substantially as-is because it directly supports practical complete run-bucket timing, safe allocation, exact execution, compatibility, or regression protection.
classifications.SIMPLIFY: Retain a smaller product-facing kernel or regression; delete the campaign/proof mechanics embedded in the current component.
classifications.REMOVE: Revert/delete the R54 addition or R54 rewrite because it exists only for protected research/campaign claims or is unrelated to practical wall-time balancing.
classifications.UNCERTAIN: Do not rely on it until independently validated; it is not needed to begin salvage.

critical_findings.summary: The production record loop never ingests wall-time records.
critical_findings.impact: The next plan still learns reporter package seconds, not complete Vitest/run-bucket elapsed time.

critical_findings.summary: Wall measurement and Palloc allocation are opt-in and absent from the ordinary plan path and dogfood Vitest lane.
critical_findings.impact: R54 preserves v0.2.2 behavior by default and therefore does not deliver the stated product change.

critical_findings.summary: Palloc is trained on per-invocation physical V, not complete action A, and no production code creates its required label-evidence documents.
critical_findings.impact: The learning surface is externally fabricated/sealed rather than closed by normal runs, and its target is not the complete run-bucket duration.

critical_findings.summary: The frozen feature vector excludes historical timing and unit identity as a numeric/category signal; ordinary one-file units commonly collapse to identical predictions.
critical_findings.impact: Even a valid fitted scorer cannot learn that two same-shaped files have different runtimes.

critical_findings.summary: AllocationScore can alter packing, but est_seconds remains the reporter-EWMA sum and Aeta is a separate document not consumed by partitioning.
critical_findings.impact: The displayed prediction and the weight used to balance can disagree, and neither is learned from complete action elapsed time.

critical_findings.summary: The monotonic span is useful but is not literally the complete GitHub composite-action wall time.
critical_findings.impact: Action expression evaluation, shell startup, and post-end record/seal work sit outside the interval; installation is deliberately outside the action. Contract §2 names the observed run-bucket execution span, and names it honestly.

critical_findings.summary: Vitest whole-file units are merged into one invocation, while TrainingLabel requires one UnitID.
critical_findings.impact: There is no defensible per-unit attribution for the observed invocation duration. Preserve membership, then either learn at bucket/invocation level or emit one learnable invocation per scheduling unit.

critical_findings.summary: The reusable workflow depends on $/.github/actions/... and suppresses the linter, but the historical handoff says the external path was not exercised.
critical_findings.impact: Consumer portability is uncertain. Salvage can proceed using a known supported action reference form, so this is not an external blocker.

Keep normal discovery/store/plan outputs and a small wall-predictor input. Remove bundle, Stage-1/2, claim store, registry, scorer-signature, and authority inputs.

Keep audit-before-ingest and reporter ingestion for compatibility, then add successful complete-span ingestion. Remove candidate/release-proof inputs. This is the missing product feedback edge.

Keep one monotonic start, setup plus complete generated script, explicit status, process-group signal/reap, end, and always-uploadable observation. Remove cgroup delegation, account separation, keys, signers, stages, observers, scored eligibility, and candidate delivery.

R31-F19: call-site inspection found every symbol in these two files disconnected from the production planner - a frozen acquisition-environment snapshot, a frozen-PATH program resolver, a package-launcher delegation resolver, and the discovery argv of the acquisition closure. Each reference was a definition, a helper-internal call, or a test, so helper coverage looked like live-path coverage while the names still described a capability this product does not have. They were split out of wall-cli-and-acquisition rather than reclassified inside it: that component's R54 SIMPLIFY classification describes the files that remain, and rewriting it would falsify the salvage record instead of recording a later discovery. splitCommand, which IS live, stays in main.go.

Keep compact measure/verify/ingest commands, canonical cwd/resolved executable/actual argv capture, workflow-condition/permission checks that survive the simplified workflow, and Vitest-only opt-in safeguards. Remove the research command surface.
Pins external action immutability and one-read exact-plan audit behavior independently of the research protocol.
Deletes CLI wiring and tests whose only consumer is eligibility/proof infrastructure. Exact path and acquisition regressions are retained in the preceding groups.

Provides runner-neutral score injection, explicit unit/run identity, safe one-read bucket audit, byte parsing, Go neutrality, and matrix compatibility. Add a new wall estimate field rather than silently repurposing est_seconds.

Keep deterministic unit/membership projection and the allocator adapter. Replace the sealed static-feature scorer with a versioned, ordinary-history wall model; remove Stage receipts, replay, claims, and implementation-identity proof.
No product behavior depends on cryptographically naming each planner implementation function.
Adds data-only Units/Selector/Atoms identity without changing Go command bytes; required to attribute and audit wall observations safely.

Keep exact path tokens, actual argv, unit/selector/atom membership, reporter output, and a small direct wrapper hook. Drop Stage-frozen inputs and walltime proof coupling. Decide explicitly whether grouped whole-file invocations remain the training unit.
Preserves the regression that the retained resolved executable is the one actually run while exec.go is simplified.
Restore the fixture version selected by normal maintenance. The 4.1.10 freeze exists for the historical Mandel campaign, not practical timing.

This is the portable kernel for exact nanosecond durations, direct argv specs, safe process identity signaling, canonical observation digests, and audit results. Extract process-start identity before deleting cgroup membership files, and remove cross-process observer assumptions from comments/API.

Extract a small begin/run/end observation writer, terminal-state verifier, and online wall predictor. Eliminate cryptographic ledgers, observer coordination, campaign gates, sealed ridge lineage, and Aeta registry proof.

Port the practical assertions—complete span, failure propagation, output pass-through, whole-call bracketing, rollback, deterministic score/floor, bucket-total error, and malformed/incomplete record rejection—to the small API; delete proof-specific assertions.
Preserve TERM-to-KILL escalation, hard deadline, and owned-process-group signal and drain/reap behavior; adapt the detached-descendant case to the chosen portable process-group contract.

Deletes Linux-only containment delegation, held-child admission, privilege/account separation, nested controller sockets, membership snapshots, and process-tree proof. Practical execution falls back to owned child plus process group, signal forwarding, wait, and reap.

Deletes per-producer Ed25519 keys, delegations, rosters, seals, detached peer/trace processes, three-ledger reconciliation, and file-channel isolation. A local observation needs atomic write/rename and plan identity, not a public-key hierarchy.

Deletes frozen Stage-1/2 manifests, replay receipts, one-shot durable planner claims, source/package closure, runner-fleet attestations, and Mandel lock proof. Retain only ordinary plan digest/membership fields in the practical record.

Deletes the 12-ablation/five-pair/80-row study harness, API step observer, signed training evidence, randomized schedule, and topology-stratum proof. Replace with ordinary default-branch historical observations and normal model-quality tests.
